**Finding 1 (CHK-0102, CHK-0105): Batch Verifier DoS Amplification - Real Vulnerability**

The most significant finding is in `verifyKzgBatch` (`/home/gohan/runners/security-agent-2/_work/security-agent/security-agent/target_workspace/beacon-chain/sync/batch_verifier.go`, lines 194-214). The function:

1. Collects data columns from ALL pending `kzgVerifier` entries (from different P2P peers)
2. Verifies them together in one batch call to `VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs`
3. Sends the SAME error result to ALL verifiers regardless of which individual column caused the failure
4. All verifiers then fall back to individual verification via `validateUnbatchedColumnsKzg`

An attacker sending structurally-valid but cryptographically-invalid DataColumnSidecar messages (valid index, non-zero commitments, matching array lengths - passes `ValidFields()` - but with corrupted KZG proof bytes) can poison the batch, causing up to ~100x (kzgChan buffer size) amplification of individual KZG verification work.

The `cellIndices` in this codebase are **column identifiers** (values 0-127 representing which data column of the extended blob matrix), not **array offsets into the commitments array**.
